name: Healer
about: Keeps the party going. Energy refills on its own. Drains the life of crowds and bosses to heal the party.

E.name: Mending Vow
E.about: Put a vow on the party member nearest the mouse. When they get hit it heals them, then jumps to another party member. 1 jump, +1 per rank. Solo at full health: +20% damage for 20s instead, stacks up to 5 times.

F.name: Life Drain
F.about: Toggle. Every enemy around you loses 1% of its life per second for each enemy in range (up to 25%), and heals the party. Swiftness on your gear drains faster; Vitality heals more.
